expertExplanation.summary: The deterministic finding correctly identifies the electrical hazard from the extension cord in standing water. No additional hazards were identified that would change the decision or require further action beyond de-energizing and removing the cord.
whatMatters: The extension cord running through standing water creates an immediate electrical hazard
Worker exposure to live electrical equipment while working in wet conditions
The sump pump housing is a confined space with potential for entrapment or asphyxiation
whatIsMissing: No information about whether the worker was properly de-energized before reaching into the pump housing
No information about whether lockout/tagout procedures were followed
No information about whether the worker had proper PPE for wet conditions
No information about whether the sump pump was properly isolated from power
howConditionsInteract: The combination of standing water and electrical equipment creates a high-risk environment
Worker reaching into the pump housing while electrical equipment is energized in wet conditions increases risk of electrocution

statements: The observation does not establish whether the worker was properly de-energized before working on the pump
